description.fun: Chikorita's leaf gives off a sweet scent that calms even Pokémon in the middle of a battle, and it doubles as a weather gauge for finding a warm spot to sunbathe. One of Johto's three first partners, it's the only one whose design survived from the 1997 Space World demo of Gold and Silver, and it's still the tallest of all the first-stage first partners.
description.guide: A small, sauropod-like Grass-type Pokémon and one of Johto's three first partners, also offered in Lumiose City in Legends: Z-A. The leaf on its head gives off a soothing aroma and senses temperature and humidity. It evolves into Bayleef and then Meganium.
description.tagline: Johto's gentle starter with a calming, weather-sensing leaf

description.fun: Bayleef wears a necklace of curled leaves, each hiding a little tree shoot that gives off a spicy scent said to energise and heal, so even Pokémon napping nearby wake up refreshed. Its name puns on the bay leaf, though real bay leaves are more bitter than spicy. In the 1997 Space World demo its place went to a flowering mole called Hanamogura.
description.guide: The middle stage of the Chikorita line, a sauropod-like Grass-type Pokémon. The curled leaves around its neck each hold a tree shoot that gives off a spicy, stimulating aroma. Its name comes from the bay leaf.
description.tagline: Chikorita grown tall, with a spicy, invigorating leaf necklace

description.fun: Meganium's breath can bring withered plants back to life, and the scent of the big flower around its neck is so soothing that opponents lose the will to fight and may even doze off beside it. Its name blends 'mega' with geranium. In Legends: Z-A it gained a Mega Evolution with four flowers, a Fairy type and the power to fire Solar Beam in an instant.
description.guide: The final form of Chikorita, a large, sauropod-like Grass-type Pokémon with a flower around its neck. The flower's aroma calms people and Pokémon, and its breath can revive withered plants. In Legends: Z-A it can Mega Evolve into Mega Meganium.
description.tagline: A long-necked peacemaker whose flower calms any fight

description.fun: Mega Evolution makes Meganium bigger, with four flowers in red, pinks and white stacked around its neck. They store so much sunlight that it can fire Solar Beam from all four at once, and it turns Grass and Fairy, though the extra power makes it bolder and a little careless.
